guidance.statement: Achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8-10% going forward
guidance.quote: demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.statement: Maintain margin guidance in the 18-20% band
guidance.quote: we should see how we can retain our margin guidance going forward... Absolutely right. We are maintaining our margin guidance, which is there.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.statement: Commission first phase (VAE) of the VAM-VAE project in the first half of the year
guidance.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

growth_commentary: Volume growth returned to double digits at 12.4% for decorative and 12.7% for overall coatings in Q4.
Demand conditions improved across all three months, with rural growth slightly outpacing urban growth.
Gross margins reached an all-time high of about 45.6% aided by deflation of about 1.4% in Q4.
Premiumization strategy worked well, improving product mix with PreLux categories performing strongly.

pushback.question: Have you passed on the entire cost impact including rupee depreciation, and what are the thoughts on further price hikes?
pushback.answer: Management stated they have passed on around 11% against an impact closer to 20%, intending to absorb some part through cost excellence and material efficiencies while exploring further calibrated increases.

pushback.question: Does competitive intensity still mean high discounting in an inflationary environment?
pushback.answer: Management confirmed there is no let-up in discounting across retailers and contractors from existing and new players, and discounting differentials remain unchanged.

pushback.question: What gives confidence to maintain 18-20% margin guidance even if crude remains in the $90-$100 band?
pushback.answer: Confidence stems from potential further price hikes in the first six months, a stronger product mix via premiumization, backward integration benefits, and disciplined market spending.
